events.title: Empowerment Yoga
events.description: Start your Sunday with a community yoga flow and good vibes to boost your energy and calm your mind. Every Sunday at Emancipation Park, alone or with the family. Each session takes in breathwork, yoga flow, sound meditation, and time to be among people.
events.arrival_notes: Meet at Pavilion C, by the softball field.
